issue_context.title: portabled can't be introspected via DBus
issue_context.body:
**systemd version the issue has been seen with**
https://github.com/systemd/systemd/commit/1ab191b3a95cd511e630e24555ed50205d1ed220

The `/org/freedesktop/portable1/image` hierarchy can't be introspected and it prevents programs like `busctl`, `gdbus` and `dfuzzer` from discovering images automatically (which is the point of the introspection in general)
```sh
# busctl tree org.freedesktop.portable1 --no-pager
Failed to introspect object /org/freedesktop/portable1/image of service org.freedesktop.portable1: Expected image name, not path in place of ''.
└─/org
  └─/org/freedesktop
    ├─/org/freedesktop/LogControl1
    └─/org/freedesktop/portable1

# busctl introspect org.freedesktop.portable1 /org/freedesktop/portable1/image
Failed to introspect object /org/freedesktop/portable1/image of service org.freedesktop.portable1: Expected image name, not path in place of ''.
```

review_comments: I'm not sure about this change, why should errors acquiring the bus not be propagated? Apart from ENOENT obvs

I think the issue is that `object_path_startswith()` is returning false, even though it's comparing two identical strings:

```
3970	        e = object_path_startswith(path, prefix);
(gdb) p path
$1 = 0x55c5a166f768 "/org/freedesktop/portable1/image"
(gdb) p prefix
$2 = 0x55c59ffc2928 "/org/freedesktop/portable1/image"
(gdb) p e
$1 = 0x5581a1675788 ""
(gdb) n
3971	        if (!e) {
(gdb) n
3976	        ret = bus_label_unescape(e);
```

That doesn't seem right?
it should probably check with `isempty` rather than just for null
this should be a hard error, not an ignore, because ID is mandatory - it needs to be propagated back to the caller
also this is not the extension's, this is the host's?
I'll send a PR shortly with an alternative fix
